# Ing. Bryan Marc — Full-Stack Developer

> Ing. Bryan Marc Sosa Morán is a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Puerto Plata, Dominican Republic. He designs and builds mobile apps, web platforms, desktop apps (Windows/macOS), custom SaaS software and AI voice agents for startups and established companies across the Dominican Republic, Spain, Argentina and beyond. He is CEO and lead architect of EntuZona and Citaly RD.

## Services (available for hire)
- **Mobile app development** — iOS and Android with React Native, Kotlin or Flutter. MVPs, scalable products, APIs, authentication and web admin panels.
- **Web platform development** — React, Next.js, Node.js over SQL/NoSQL. Admin dashboards, e-commerce, SaaS and corporate portals.
- **Desktop app development** — Cross-platform native-feel apps for Windows and macOS with Tauri and Electron.
- **AI voice agents** — Conversational systems with OpenAI and Twilio for support, sales, reminders and 24/7 automation.
- **Management systems & custom SaaS** — Software for clinics, HR, automotive, real estate and internal operations.
- **Conversion landing pages** — Fast, SEO-optimized pages built to convert.

## Skills, by platform
- **Mobile**: React Native, Flutter, Kotlin (Android), Expo
- **Web**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js
- **Desktop**: Tauri (Windows/macOS/Linux), Electron, C# / .NET
- **Data & infrastructure**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Supabase, Docker
- **AI & automation**: OpenAI, Voice AI, Twilio, agents & workflows
- **Engineering fundamentals**: object-oriented programming, design patterns, clean code, Git, automated testing, agile methodologies, security & performance
